chunks: Yūnus narrated from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said:

One of the two Imams, peace be upon them, was asked about the hadd punishment for the mute, the deaf, and the blind. He said: “The legal punishments apply to them if they understand what they are doing.”

key_terms.الْحُدُودُ: prescribed legal punishments in Islamic law
key_terms.حَدِّ الْأَخْرَسِ: the legal ruling concerning a mute person

ai.seo_question: Do hudud apply to a mute, deaf, or blind person in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that the prescribed hudud apply to a mute, deaf, or blind person when they possess understanding of the act they commit. The basis of liability here is comprehension and legal awareness, not physical disability itself.
